sentences.en: Juha took ten donkeys to the market.

sentences.ar: הוא עלה על אחד מהם בבוקר.
sentences.en: He got on one of them in the morning.
The road was long and quiet.
In the middle of the road he counted them.
He counted and found only nine.
He got down to the ground very fast.
He counted again, and now ten.
He got back up and continued on the road.
After a little he counted again.
Again there were only nine donkeys.
He got down and checked, and there were ten.

sentences.ar: הוא לא הבין מה קורה כאן.
sentences.en: He did not understand what is happening here.

sentences.ar: הוא החליט ללכת ברגל עד הסוף.
sentences.en: He decided to walk on foot until the end.
At the market an old friend met him.
The friend asked: why are you walking?

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: ככה יש לי עשרה.
sentences.en: Juha said: this way I have ten.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: וכשאני רוכב יש תשעה.
sentences.en: He said: and when I ride there are nine.
